ns2:course.label: General Engineering Design
ns2:course.description: Fundamental concepts in the classical and computer-based analysis and design of structural and machine components and assemblies. External loads, internal forces, and displacements in statically determinate and indeterminate configurations: kinematics of linkages, gears, and cams; static forces in machines. Prerequisite: CS 101, MATH 225, TAM 212, and TAM 251.
